method: Start from named neighbours in cataclysm_gog_r5a/call_graph.csv and functions.csv address order; compare decompiled.c bodies with HomeworldSDL/src (control flow, constants, GL enums, callees, call order of adjacent functions in the HW1 file vs address order); pointer tables and branch targets checked in original/game/cataclysm.exe with objdump and a raw .data scan; Cataclysm-only bodies named cat_<subsystem>Verb from callers/callees/fields (low unless the body pins the role). Addresses that are not yet function entries (0x00508480, 0x00508590) are marked 'needs CreateFunctions' in evidence; 0x00571611 is an off-cut of primBeveledRectSolid and gets no name. aimoves/dock-salcap/sensors-nebulae: every FUN_* inside the HW1 file address ranges is covered here; no FUN_* is left in the AIMoves.c (0x00406e90-0x0040e160), Dock.c (0x004631f0-0x00467b00) or Nebulae.c (0x004c7b30-0x004cb800) ranges, so their unmatched HW1 defs are inlined, folded or absent in Cataclysm.
